parameters.query: SELECT phone_e164, message, created_at FROM public.n8n_chat_histories WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND created_at < date_trunc('month', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 day' ORDER BY phone_e164, created_at ASC;

WITH month_data AS (
  SELECT phone_e164, message, created_at
  FROM public.n8n_chat_histories
  WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 month' AND created_at < date_trunc('month', NOW()) - INTERVAL '1 day'
),
per_user AS (
  SELECT
    phone_e164,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(CASE WHEN message::jsonb->>'type' = 'human' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS human,
    SUM(CASE WHEN message::jsonb->>'type' != 'human' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assistant
  FROM month_data
  GROUP BY phone_e164
),
human_counts AS (
  SELECT phone_e164, SUM(CASE WHEN message::jsonb->>'type' = 'human' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cnt
  FROM month_data
  GROUP BY phone_e164
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM per_user) AS unique_clients,
  (SELECT SUM(total) FROM per_user) AS total_messages,
  (SELECT SUM(human) FROM per_user) AS total_human,
  (SELECT SUM(assistant) FROM per_user) AS total_assistant,
  ROUND((SELECT SUM(total) FROM per_user)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM per_user), 0), 1) AS avg_messages_per_user,
  ROUND((SELECT SUM(human) FROM per_user)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM per_user), 0), 1) AS avg_human_per_user,
  ROUND((SELECT SUM(assistant) FROM per_user)::numeric / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM per_user), 0), 1) AS avg_assistant_per_user,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM human_counts WHERE cnt = 1) AS single_message_users,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT phone_e164) FROM month_data
    WHERE message::jsonb->>'type' = 'human'
      AND (message::jsonb->>'content' ~* '(operator|agent|\mom\M|persoana|\mreal\M|uman|human|reprezentant|ajutor\s+real)')
  ) AS escalation_users,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM human_counts WHERE cnt = 1) AS dist_1msg,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM human_counts WHERE cnt BETWEEN 2 AND 5) AS dist_2to5,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM human_counts WHERE cnt > 5) AS dist_5plus,
  (SELECT json_agg(sub ORDER BY sub.total DESC) FROM (SELECT phone_e164, total, human, assistant FROM per_user ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10) sub) AS top_users_json;
